nodes.label: How a transformer works
nodes.description: A transformer reads the text so far and gives a probability for every possible next character. One character is picked and added to the text, and the model runs again. Choose any idea to see how it fits in.

nodes.label: Your text
nodes.description: What you type. The Fables model uses only the last 64 characters of it.

nodes.label: Tokens
nodes.description: The text is cut into pieces called tokens, and each piece gets an id number. The models in this app use one token per character.

nodes.label: Embeddings
nodes.description: Each token id picks out one row of a table: a list of numbers called its embedding. The numbers are learned in training.

nodes.label: Position
nodes.description: A list of numbers that marks a token's place in the text, added to its embedding. The Fables model learns them; the sine and cosine scheme is a fixed alternative.

nodes.label: Residual stream
nodes.description: Each token's running vector. It starts as the embedding plus the position, and every attention and feed-forward layer adds its result to it.

nodes.label: Block
nodes.description: One block holds an attention step and a feed-forward step, each adding its result to the residual stream. The model repeats the block; the Fables model has 2.

nodes.label: Attention
nodes.description: How a token gathers information from itself and the tokens before it, using a query, a key and a value for each token.

nodes.label: Multi-head
nodes.description: Several attention heads side by side, each making its own weighted average. The Fables model has 4 heads in each block.

nodes.label: Feed-forward
nodes.description: A small network that works on each token by itself, after attention. Its result is added back to the residual stream.

nodes.label: Output & sampling
nodes.description: The output layer gives every character a score. Softmax turns the scores into probabilities, and sampling picks one: by default at random, in proportion to those probabilities.

nodes.label: Next character
nodes.description: One character, picked from the probabilities. It is added to the end of the text, and the model runs again.

nodes.label: Learning
nodes.description: Changing a model's numbers so that its loss, a single number that measures how wrong it is, gets smaller.

nodes.label: Rules vs learning
nodes.description: Two writers side by side: one follows hand-written rules, the other is a small table of scores that learns from examples.

nodes.label: Architecture map
nodes.description: The whole model on one page, with the real model running underneath it.

nodes.label: Train a model
nodes.description: Choose a text and the shape of a transformer, then watch it learn from the text.

nodes.label: Step through
nodes.description: Follow one prediction through the model step by step, with the real numbers at every step.

nodes.label: Scale
nodes.description: Count the numbers in each part of the model and compare the total with GPT-2 and GPT-3.

nodes.label: Family tree
nodes.description: A tree of the kinds of AI, written by a person, learned from examples or learned from reward: choose a member to see what it is good and bad at.

nodes.label: Expert system
nodes.description: An animal-identifying system of if-then rules: describe an animal, follow which rules fired, and edit the rules yourself.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.description: Play tic-tac-toe against a program that looks ahead with minimax, and see the moves it weighed and how many positions it checked.

nodes.label: Classic ML
nodes.description: Place points of up to three classes and watch a decision tree or nearest neighbours give every place on the plot a class.

nodes.label: Learning by reward
nodes.description: Edit a maze and watch an agent learn its way to the goal from rewards alone, with each square's value and preferred move shown.

nodes.label: Image filters
nodes.description: A small filter slides over a digit to make a feature map. Coming in a later part of the app.

nodes.label: Image network
nodes.description: A small convolutional network reads a digit you draw. Coming in a later part of the app.

nodes.label: Memory networks
nodes.description: A recurrent network, with a memory carried from character to character, compared with the transformer. Coming in a later part of the app.

nodes.label: Diffusion: shapes
nodes.description: A toy that learns to turn random noise into a shape. Coming in a later part of the app.

nodes.label: Diffusion: steps
nodes.description: Inside one denoising step of the diffusion toy. Coming in a later part of the app.

nodes.label: Beyond the model
nodes.description: Coming in a later stage of the app.
